figurative_meaning_en: Beautiful smooth structure or sleek appearance
similar_in_english: All that glitters is not gold
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর চেহারা চিকণ-চাকণ, কিন্তু ভিতরে খালি।
ঘরের বাইরের অংশ চিকণ-চাকণ করে সাজানো হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has a sleek appearance, but inside he's empty.
The exterior of the house has been polished to look glossy.
history: Often paired with 'উপরে চিকণ-চাকণ ভিতরে খেড়' to imply superficial beauty hiding emptiness, rooted in everyday observations of polished but hollow objects.
note: The idiom highlights contrasts between outer polish and inner substance in Bengali expressive language.
